jp: 細長く枝分かれした体を持つ海藻。１メートル以上になることもある。食感と喉越しに優れるが、酢漬けにされることが多く、あまり好かれない。\n#～海藻と海草の違い～
jp_grezzo: "細長く枝分かれした体を持つ海藻。１メートル以上になることもある。食感と喉越しに優れるが、酢漬けにされることが多く、あまり好かれない。\n#～海藻と海草の違い～"
en: A seaweed with long, slender, branched bodies that can grow to over a meter in length. It has an excellent texture and throat, but is often pickled in vinegar and is not well-liked.\n#~Seaweed is not Sea Weed~
en_grezzo: "A seaweed with long, slender, branched bodies that can grow to over a meter in length. It has an excellent texture and throat, but is often pickled in vinegar and is not well-liked.\n#~Seaweed is not Sea Weed~"
it: Un'alga dal corpo lungo, sottile e ramificato, che a volte passa il metro. La consistenza è ottima e scende bene in gola, ma la si mette quasi sempre sott'aceto, e per questo non piace a molti.\n#~Alghe e Piante Marine: la Differenza~

en: It's seaweed. You can eat it I guess.\n#~Identification Report: <Seaweed> Category~
en_grezzo: "It's seaweed. You can eat it I guess.\n#~Identification Report: <Seaweed> Category~"
it: Un'alga. Si può mangiare, credo.\n#~Rapporto di Identificazione: categoria <Alghe>~

jp: とても長くなる海藻。水分も多いためかなり重い。干すのにもコツがいるが、乾燥するといいダシが取れるようになる。\n#～海藻と海草の違い～
jp_grezzo: "とても長くなる海藻。水分も多いためかなり重い。干すのにもコツがいるが、乾燥するといいダシが取れるようになる。\n#～海藻と海草の違い～"
en: Seaweed that grows very long. It is also quite heavy due to its high water content. It takes some skill to dry it, but when it dries, it makes a good broth.\n#~Seaweed is not Sea Weed~
en_grezzo: "Seaweed that grows very long. It is also quite heavy due to its high water content. It takes some skill to dry it, but when it dries, it makes a good broth.\n#~Seaweed is not Sea Weed~"
it: Un'alga che diventa lunghissima. Ha molta acqua dentro, e perciò pesa parecchio. Farla seccare richiede il suo mestiere, ma da secca se ne ricava un buon brodo.\n#~Alghe e Piante Marine: la Differenza~

en: Giant seaweed. You can eat it I guess.\n#~Identification Report: <Seaweed> Category~
en_grezzo: "Giant seaweed. You can eat it I guess.\n#~Identification Report: <Seaweed> Category~"
it: Un'alga gigantesca. Si può mangiare, credo.\n#~Rapporto di Identificazione: categoria <Alghe>~

jp: 大型の海藻。海中の栄養を吸ってどんどん増える。一部の地域では古くから様々な料理の具材として重宝されてきた。\n#～海藻と海草の違い～
jp_grezzo: "大型の海藻。海中の栄養を吸ってどんどん増える。一部の地域では古くから様々な料理の具材として重宝されてきた。\n#～海藻と海草の違い～"
en: Large seaweed. It grows rapidly by absorbing nutrients from the sea. In some regions, it has long been valued as an ingredient in various dishes.\n#~Seaweed is not Sea Weed~
en_grezzo: "Large seaweed. It grows rapidly by absorbing nutrients from the sea. In some regions, it has long been valued as an ingredient in various dishes.\n#~Seaweed is not Sea Weed~"
it: Un'alga di taglia grande. Assorbe il nutrimento del mare e si moltiplica in fretta. In certe regioni, fin da tempi antichi, è tenuta cara come ingrediente di piatti d'ogni sorta.\n#~Alghe e Piante Marine: la Differenza~

en: Huge seaweed. You can eat it I guess.\n#~Identification Report: <Seaweed> Category~
en_grezzo: "Huge seaweed. You can eat it I guess.\n#~Identification Report: <Seaweed> Category~"
it: Un'alga grande. Si può mangiare, credo.\n#~Rapporto di Identificazione: categoria <Alghe>~
